class.name: EditorInspectorPlugin
class.brief_description: Plugin for adding custom property editors on the inspector.
class.description: [EditorInspectorPlugin] allows adding custom property editors to [EditorInspector]. When an object is edited, the [method _can_handle] function is called and must return [code]true[/code] if the object type is supported. If supported, the function [method _parse_begin] will be called, allowing to place custom controls at the beginning of the class. Subsequently, the [method _parse_category] and [method _parse_property] are called for every category and property. They offer the ability to add custom controls to the inspector too. Finally, [method _parse_end] will be called. On each of these calls, the "add" functions can be called. To use [EditorInspectorPlugin], register it using the [method EditorPlugin.add_inspector_plugin] method first.

method.name: _can_handle
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this object can be handled by this plugin.

method.name: _parse_begin
method.description: Called to allow adding controls at the beginning of the property list for [param object].

method.name: _parse_category
method.description: Called to allow adding controls at the beginning of a category in the property list for [param object]. See also [method _parse_category_header].

method.name: _parse_category_header
method.description: Called before creating Category headers in the inspector. This method allows to prepend controls to a category header and/or suppress it. If the returned value is [code]true[/code] the default header will not be added. [codeblocks] [gdscript] # Remove a specific Category Header func _parse_category_header(object: Object, category: String) -> bool: if category == "Label": return true return false [/gdscript] [/codeblocks] [codeblocks] [gdscript] # Replace a Category Header func _parse_category_header(object: Object, category: String) -> bool: if category == "Label": var label = Label.new() label.text = "This is a custom %s Header" % category add_custom_control(label) return true return false [/gdscript] [/codeblocks] [note]To place controls after the Category header see [method _parse_category].[/note]

method.name: _parse_end
method.description: Called to allow adding controls at the end of the property list for [param object].

method.name: _parse_group
method.description: Called to allow adding controls at the beginning of a group or a sub-group in the property list for [param object]. See also [method _parse_group_section].

method.name: _parse_group_section
method.description: Called to allow adding controls before a group or sub-group in the property list for [param object]. This function should return a [VBoxContainer] or [code]null[/code]. If null is returned a default group foldable section will be created. If a [VBoxContainer] is returned, it should have been added to the tree with [method add_custom_control]. [codeblocks] [gdscript] # Custom Group Container func _parse_group_section(object: Object, group: String) -> VBoxContainer: if group == "Visibility": var container := FoldableContainer.new() container.title = group var vbox := VBoxContainer.new() container.add_child(vbox) add_custom_control(container) return vbox return null [/gdscript] [/codeblocks] [codeblocks] [gdscript] # Show contents of a group without making a default foldable container func _parse_group_section(object: Object, group: String) -> VBoxContainer: var vbox := VBoxContainer.new() add_custom_control(vbox) return vbox [/gdscript] [/codeblocks] [note]To place custom controls inside the default group section use [method _parse_group].[/note]

method.name: _parse_property
method.description: Called to allow adding property-specific editors to the property list for [param object]. The added editor control must extend [EditorProperty]. Returning [code]true[/code] removes the built-in editor for this property, otherwise allows to insert a custom editor before the built-in one.

method.name: add_custom_control
method.description: Adds a custom control, which is not necessarily a property editor.

method.name: add_property_editor
method.description: Adds a property editor for an individual property. The [param editor] control must extend [EditorProperty]. There can be multiple property editors for a property. If [param add_to_end] is [code]true[/code], this newly added editor will be displayed after all the other editors of the property whose [param add_to_end] is [code]false[/code]. For example, the editor uses this parameter to add an "Edit Region" button for [member Sprite2D.region_rect] below the regular [Rect2] editor. [param label] can be used to choose a custom label for the property editor in the inspector. If left empty, the label is computed from the name of the property instead.

method.name: add_property_editor_for_multiple_properties
method.description: Adds an editor that allows modifying multiple properties. The [param editor] control must extend [EditorProperty].
